reasoning_content: Now install Rust. Let me install rustup non-interactively.

action.command: export RUSTUP_HOME=/root/.rustup CARGO_HOME=/root/.cargo; curl -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs -o /tmp/rustup.sh && sh /tmp/rustup.sh -y --default-toolchain stable --profile minimal >/tmp/rustup-install.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; tail -5 /tmp/rustup-install.log; . /root/.cargo/env; rustc --version; cargo --version

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "export RUSTUP_HOME=/root/.rustup CARGO_HOME=/root/.cargo; curl -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs -o /tmp/rustup.sh && sh /tmp/rustup.sh -y --default-toolchain stable --profile minimal >/tmp/rustup-install.log 2>&1; echo \"exit=$?\"; tail -5 /tmp/rustup-install.log; . /root/.cargo/env; rustc --version; cargo --version", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Install Rust toolchain via rustup"}
